checks.name: public_entrypoint
checks.command: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');const bins=typeof p.bin==='string'?{[p.name]:p.bin}:p.bin;if(!bins||!Object.keys(bins).length)throw Error('package has no CLI executable');for(const [name,file] of Object.entries(bins)){if(typeof file!=='string'||!file)throw Error('invalid executable: '+name);const r=require('child_process').spawnSync(process.execPath,[require('path').resolve(file),'--help'],{encoding:'utf8',stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe'],timeout:15000});if(r.error||r.status!==0)throw Error(name+' --help failed: '+(r.error?.message||r.stderr||r.status));console.log(name+' --help passed')}"
